name: Amira Inbound WhatsApp
summary: Inbound WhatsApp handler: store first, then route on next_action.
description: Import, then swap the Manual Trigger for Catch Webhook in the UI, publish, and set the flow URL as the WhatsApp channel webhookUrl. record_inbound indexes the message, opens the 24h window, and returns the lead pack; routing: ask_channel (button/keyword fast path, inbound-brain for everything semantic), gather (inbound-brain), stop. contact.opted_out marks the lead suppressed. Variables required: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, AgenticFlow_API_KEY.
author: amira
